signal: three-session return >=15% with >=2 up sessions, followed immediately by an inside day with -3% to +3% return, turnover <=70% of the impulse three-session mean, and close in the prior range's upper half
entry: next legal executable session open, at most three market-session indices after signal
target: +15% from executable entry, first legal realization after T+1
time_stop: H30 completed market-session indices, then next legal executable open
known_instability: 2017 and 2018 development means are negative; 2022-2023 must be treated as external confirmation, not tuning data.
